notes: 8 configurations, 7 equipment entries, 5 manufacturers/brands (MVE Biological Solutions, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Epredia, Helmer Scientific; NIST used only as reference data). All accessed 2026-11-01. Every configuration documents all 11 core-passport keys; the only gap is sample.height.max for the Epredia CryoStar NX70 (no maximum specimen height stated anywhere; recorded as unknown and listed in not_found). Absences (magnet, sample vacuum, base pressure, viewport, sample wiring) are install=not_available, quoting the complete spec sheet/technical-data section that defines the machine's scope. Conventions: single stated storage temperature -> lo = hi (MVE HEco -190 C top box; XC 47/11 liquid-phase storage at the LN2 normal boiling point 77.34 K from NIST reference data, because MVE documents only 'liquid storage' without a number). Vapour shippers use the MVE manual range -150 to -190 C. Front-loading CRF chamber: diameter = smaller cross-section perpendicular to loading (30.5 cm height), height = depth along loading axis (33 cm). Upright freezers follow the family mapping (smaller of interior width/depth; interior height). Conservative choices: XC 47/11-6 straw/vial counts conflict between the 2024 spec sheet (4,500+ / 6,216 bulk) and the MVE product page (3900+ straws, 1320 vials) -> lower cane-inventory figures used; CryoMed 48 L vials 1,185 (not 1,195). Not recorded: HEco static hold time (only a 'typical performance' graph), XC 47/11 static hold (only a nominal evaporation rate and an 'arbitrary' working duration; consumption rate stored instead, rounded up to 0.000271 L/min). Considered but excluded because core keys could not be sourced: Philips BlueSeal 1.5 T sealed MRI magnet (field 1.5 T, 70 cm bore, ~7 L sealed helium, no refills documented in https://www.philips.com/c-dam/b2bhc/master/resource-catalog/landing/the-next-mr-wave/Brochure_BlueSeal.pdf, but no patient-bore temperature/vacuum/viewport data); Cytiva VIA Freeze Quad (no reachable manufacturer datasheet). Quotes from PDFs were read from the manufacturers' PDFs (text extraction); Thermo TSX and Fisher NX70 quotes are rows of the web specification tables ('Name: value' rendering). The CryoMed medical-device brochure URL is on a Thermo Fisher China asset host (qa1-assets.thermofisher.cn).
